acid--acid-blue.description: Part of ACID, the infused range Drew Estate started in 1996, made with curing and blending methods kept private at La Gran Fábrica in Nicaragua. Blue, the original ACID line, is mellow and smooth, with a sweet, herbal and aromatic smoke, in sizes from the small Krush to the Kuba Kuba and the 6 x 60 Kuba Grande.

thirds.notes: A sweet, botanical start with floral and vanilla tones that settles onto cedar, leather and earth, with a sharp spice early on.
The infusion eases a little as dried fruit, leather and cedar come through, with warm spice and a grassy, earthy edge.
The same core holds to the end, earthier and spicier, while a sugary sweetness stays on the lips.

acid--acid-gold.description: Part of ACID, the infused range Drew Estate started in 1996, made with curing and blending methods kept private at La Gran Fábrica in Nicaragua. Gold is a separate blend with its own golden, sweet aroma, offered as the Krush Gold, Blondie Gold, Atom Maduro and the slim Cold Infusion.

acid--acid-morado.description: Part of ACID, the infused range Drew Estate started in 1996, made with curing and blending methods kept private at La Gran Fábrica in Nicaragua. Morado, the purple ACID, uses hand-selected Nicaraguan tobacco with a deep infusion and a rich, juicy bouquet, from the Croqueta and Krush Purple up to the Extra Ordinary Larry.

acid--acid-green.description: Part of ACID, the infused range Drew Estate started in 1996, made with curing and blending methods kept private at La Gran Fábrica in Nicaragua. Green uses a candela wrapper, the green leaf that was America's most common wrapper until the early 1980s, and smokes mellow, grassy, earthy and herbal.

acid--acid-20.description: Part of ACID, the infused range Drew Estate started in 1996, made with curing and blending methods kept private at La Gran Fábrica in Nicaragua. ACID 20 marks the brand's first twenty years, with a sweet, aromatic infusion and warm spice, in a box-pressed Maduro Robusto, a Maduro Toro and a Connecticut Toro.

thirds.notes: Sweet and floral from the infusion, over an earthy base with leather and cedar or cocoa, and a little pepper through the nose.
Mellower, with soil, herbal and floral notes and a fruity, orange-like sweetness; pepper grows on the retrohale.
Warm earth and a touch more pepper lead the close; the infusion returns strongly in some sizes and fades in others.

acid--acid-subculture.description: Part of ACID, the infused range Drew Estate started in 1996, made with curing and blending methods kept private at La Gran Fábrica in Nicaragua. Subculture is a series of small-batch infused blends for dedicated ACID smokers, made from limited, higher-grade tobaccos.
